intro.text: A Rosharan creature that is hard to catch: Shallan likens the elusive Jasnah to one.
A fist-sized Rosharan creature shaped like a peaked disc. It scrapes four arms over its ridged shell to make a percussive, rattling sound, and clings to rock with four squat legs.

description.text: Songlings are hard to catch; Shallan likens the elusive Jasnah to one.
Each songling keeps up its own repeating beat and tone.
Songlings live in the brush. Shallan remembers wild songlings near her Jah Keved home singing in rival choruses.

items.text: Balat's axehound Scrak caught a songling and ate part of it.
Wit tried and failed to copy a songling's sound on his pipes, but the songlings answered his music and his voice, and he held a conversation with them.
